page_note: 该页展示一张未编号的柱状图：四个分位数(Quartile 1–4)的全球直投私募基金TVPI柱子，加一条代表Vantage 2.1x的青色横向参考线，右上角有黑底白字说明框。

heading.title: Vantage has Generated Top Quartile Returns when Compared to Global Direct Private Equity Funds
heading.subtitle: Vantage vs Global Private Equity (Direct Buyout Funds) TVPI - 2009-2018

figures.source_line: Source: Based on global private equity returns on a Total Value Paid In basis from 2009-2018, Persistence in Alternative Strategies:  Private Equity Buyout, Preqin. Vantage TVPI based on VPEG2 and VPEG3 TVPI as at 31 March 2025.

components.evidence: teal horizontal rule spanning the plot just above the 2.0x gridline, legend entry "VANTAGE"
four grey vertical bars plus a full-width teal line with a round icon marker in one panel
black box over the plot's top right: "Vantage has generated a 2.1x platform wide Net Multiple ... Direct Buyout"
thin horizontal rules at 0.5x through 3.0x across the panel; no vertical rules
"VANTAGE" and "GLOBAL PRIVATE EQUITY" stacked in a column at the left, level with the plot
two lines of small print under the plot beginning "Source: Based on global private equity returns..."
heading line reads "...(Direct Buyout Funds) TVPI - 2009-2018"; axis shows bare multiples "0.5x"–"3.0x"

new_components.name: logo_marker_on_reference_line
new_components.evidence: circular Vantage brand icon badge sits on the teal line above Quartile 1 and serves as the legend swatch
new_components.why_it_matters: 该系列的值只能从横线高度读取，图标遮挡了线与2.0x刻度的关系，容易把2.1x误读成2.0x。

new_components.name: unlabeled_zero_baseline
new_components.evidence: lowest printed tick is "0.5x"; bars rest on an unlabeled baseline well below it
new_components.why_it_matters: 零点无刻度标签，读柱高时须自行外推半个刻度间距，绝对值容易系统性偏低或偏高。

new_components.name: value_only_in_callout_text
new_components.evidence: the only number on the figure, "2.1x", appears inside the black note box, not as a data label
new_components.why_it_matters: 表格若只抄柱子，2.1x会丢失；解析器须把标注框文字当作该系列的唯一数值来源。

difficulty_notes: 五个待核值里有四个完全没有印在图上，唯一印出的是标注框里的"2.1x"。刻度间距为0.5x，而5%容差在1.0x上只有±0.05，即刻度间距的十分之一；1.7x与1.4x都落在两条网格线之间，必须按像素内插，且最低标签是0.5x、零基线无标签，外推误差直接叠加。相比之下标签只需"GLOBAL PRIVATE EQUITY"+"Quartile n"两键即可唯一定位，并不构成瓶颈。
